rounds.text: Banaras Beads is currently undergoing a significant operational transformation, evidenced by a massive 61% growth in trailing twelve-month sales [E17] and a 57% surge in profit growth over the same period [E21]. This momentum is further validated by a dramatic expansion in operating margins, which have climbed by 6 percentage points over the last three years and 5 percentage points in the most recent quarter [E30, E31]. While the market remains fixated on historical averages, the company is actively outperforming expectations, with recent profit growth exceeding one-year price growth by 79% [E55]. The stock is attractively priced relative to its sector peers, trading at a price-to-book ratio of 1.2x compared to the sector benchmark of 1.97x [E7]. Furthermore, management has demonstrated long-term commitment by increasing their stake in the company [E40]. Conceded: [E4, E8, E9, E10, E12, E13, E34, E35, E36, E43, E44, E45, E48, E50, E51, E52, E58, E59, E60].
